palette: dark olive bindery ground + sewn parchment amendment leaves + crimson linen thread lines + brass grommets + gold year labels + dark sewing ink
typography: ink headings on parchment leaves, dark bindery label tabs with gold left bar, crimson thread underlines for year rows, gold chips for amendment numbers, thin ink underline for key insertions
composition: the founding timeline stretches as a sewn spine with document leaves; the 1988-1993 and 1999-2004 benches lay out amendment rows per year; the 2018 cluster boards its biggest insertions; the mnemonic leaf rhymes the recurrences
surface: flat dark olive ground with faint sewing-guide hairlines, parchment leaves with hairline weathered borders and grommet dots, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: leaves are sewn onto the spine one by one, year labels ink in, thread lines draw across recurring themes, the 2018 cluster leaves unfold outward
transition: the bindery thread pulls taut and the bench clears for the next signature
